title: Ring of Shadows
summary: Cast Pass Without Trace once per Long Rest.

fields.Pass Without Trace: Level 2, Action on yourself once per Long Rest. While concentrating until Long Rest, you and allies within 30 ft gain +10 to Stealth checks.
fields.Acquisition: Play both rounds of hide-and-seek with Oliver at the House in Deep Shadows. Winning is optional.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
